GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 130 (14 Dec 45) ESS/FI
(SCAPIN - 441)
APO 500
14 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Transactions in Shares and Debentures Issued by Companies having their Head Offices outside of Japan
1. Reference is made to C.L.O. Memorandum No. 980 (2.1), dated 8 December 1945, requesting permission for transactions in Japan in shares and debentures issued by companies having their head office outside of Japan.
2. This request is disapproved.
3. An acknowledgement of the receipt of this memorandum is directed.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General
